verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents a Dashboard export of all invoices, or a subset, as CSV, which is an open format. Individual invoices or receipts can also be downloaded as PDFs. However, the evidence covers only invoice records, not a complete export of all account data, and says nothing about leaving or migrating off the platform. Missing for 10: full-account export (customers, products, credit notes, payments), documented bulk/machine-readable export beyond invoice CSV, migration/offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export all of your invoices or a subset of them as a CSV file by clicking Export on the Invoices page.
Depending on the invoice status, clicking the button downloads either a PDF of the invoice or a receipt.
